name: Block Editor with Slash Menu
note: A contenteditable-per-block document whose state is an array of typed blocks: a caret-anchored slash menu filters with arrow keys, markdown prefixes convert blocks as you type, and handles drag-reorder with a WAAPI FLIP while the outline rail scroll-spies headings and a scroll() timeline fades the title into the top bar. Set --ape-blocks-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Code Editor Shell
note: A transparent textarea over a re-tokenised highlight layer gives real editing with auto-indent, line comments and lint squiggles; a DPR-aware canvas minimap with a draggable viewport, a fuzzy quick-open palette and a terminal whose ls, cat, git status and npm test read the same in-memory files. Set --ape-code-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Formula Spreadsheet
note: A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser feed a dependency graph, so an edit recalculates only its dependents in topological order and they flash in a wave staggered by graph depth; while a formula is being typed its references are colour-matched in the bar and on the grid, and the fill handle rewrites relative references. Set --ape-sheet-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Whiteboard with Pan and Zoom
note: One camera (x, y, zoom) drives a transformed world layer and, through custom properties, the dot-grid background; zoom anchors on the cursor, connectors are re-clipped to box edges as notes move, marquee and minimap work in world space, and frame jumps tween the camera on a spring. Set --ape-board-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Code Review Diff
note: The diff is computed in the browser: Myers O(ND) over lines, then again over word tokens for paired edits, grouped into hunks with expandable context; split and unified views render from the same op list, and dragging along line numbers opens a multi-line comment thread. Set --ape-review-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Video Timeline Editor
note: A non-linear editor: clips move, trim and split with magnetic snapping to edits and the playhead, J/K/L shuttle drives a canvas monitor that renders each procedural scene and title at the playhead, and the loop sleeps when off screen or hidden. Set --ape-cut-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Design Tool Canvas
note: Layers, canvas and inspector bound to one scene graph: dragging snaps to sibling and frame edges and centres with live gap measurements, holding Option redlines the distance to the hovered layer, inspector labels scrub values on drag, and an Inspect tab writes the selection out as CSS. Set --ape-design-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Sprite Editor
note: Indexed-colour frames on a DPR-aware canvas with Bresenham lines, scanline flood fill, mirror drawing and onion skinning, so swapping a colour ramp recolours every frame without touching a pixel; frames drag-reorder with FLIP and the preview loop pauses off screen or in a hidden tab. Set --ape-pixel-h to 100dvh in an app.
